children: Kingstown, St. Vincent and the Grenadines, September 2nd, 2026, FinanceWire

Changelly, a leading instant crypto exchange platform, is launching the Golden Boost Campaign offering $20,000 in XAUT rewards to 100 winners, with support from Tether, a pioneer in the field of stablecoin technology.

From September 1 to September 20, 2026, registered Changelly users who swap $50 or more of any supported cryptocurrency into USDT or XAUT can enter the giveaway. Choosing Tether Gold comes with an extra advantage: on Changelly, every qualifying XAUT swap earns double entries, giving participants more opportunities to earn a share of the $20,000 reward pool.
Own Tether Gold: Digital and Timeless

Gold has held its value for centuries as a safe haven in times of uncertainty. Tether Gold brings this familiar asset on-chain, combining ownership of physical gold with the flexibility of a digital token—and is already available on Changelly.

Each Tether Gold (XAUT) token represents ownership of one fine troy ounce of physical gold on a specific gold bar that meets the LBMA Good Delivery standard. XAUT can also be divided into increments as small as 0.000001 fine troy ounce, making fractional ownership possible without buying an entire gold bar. XAUT is currently available as an ERC-20 token on Ethereum and a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain.

Together, USDT and XAUT offer two distinct ways to hold value on-chain: USDT provides dollar-pegged liquidity, while XAUT provides direct exposure to physical gold in digital form. Both assets are available on Changelly, allowing users to move from supported cryptocurrencies into dollar-pegged or gold-backed assets in just a few clicks.
Joining the Golden Boost Campaign
Registered Changelly users can join by completing a qualifying $50 or more crypto-to-crypto swap into USDT or XAUT during the campaign period.
Log in to a registered Changelly account.
Swap $50 or more of any supported crypto into USDT or XAUT.
Earn 1 entry for every qualifying USDT swap or 2 entries for every qualifying XAUT swap with the Golden Boost.

There is no limit to the number of qualifying swaps a user can complete during the campaign. Every additional swap earns additional entries. Cross-chain USDT swaps, as well as failed, canceled, refunded, reversed, or otherwise incomplete transactions, do not qualify.
The campaign isn’t available to residents of the United States, the United Kingdom, Singapore, or Canada. Full eligibility rules are available here.
$20,000 in XAUT Rewards

At the end of the campaign, 100 participants will receive a share of the $20,000 reward pool. Individual reward amounts will vary based on each winner’s total qualifying swap volume during the campaign and will be scaled so that the aggregate value of all rewards equals $20,000 in XAUT.

Within seven calendar days after the campaign ends, the winners will be contacted via the email address associated with their Changelly account. Selected participants will have three calendar days to respond and provide a valid wallet address capable of receiving XAUТ. Rewards will be distributed within seven calendar days by Changelly after the required wallet information is received and eligibility is confirmed.
Each participant can receive no more than one campaign reward.
More Gold, More Chances
Swap any supported cryptocurrency into XAUТ or USDT on Changelly and compete for a share of $20,000 in XAUТ rewards.
Choose XAUТ to unlock the Golden Boost and earn 2× entries with every qualifying swap.
Join the Golden Boost Campaign
